info.title: XR Daemon API
info.summary: The local-first daemon API of the XR AI agent runtime.
info.description: Versioned surface mounted at /api/v1. Legacy /api/* mounts serve during the deprecation window with Deprecation/Sunset headers and are removed no earlier than XR 8.0.0. Compatibility policy: docs/api/COMPATIBILITY.md. Authentication: local bearer token (x-session bootstrap cookie for browsers).
